result.title: MatchCityLoc: Aerial Localization in LoD City Models via Surface Normal Matching
result.summary: Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) navigation in urban environments requires precise pose estimation. Because Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signals are often unreliable in cities, visual localization serves as a crucial complement. Within this domain, textureless Level-of-Detail (LoD) city models provide a lightweight and privacy-preserving substitute for heavy 3D textured meshes. However, localizing against abstract geometry is challenging. Existing pipelines typically score 2D silhouette overlaps, which can suffer from severe geometric ambiguities. We present MatchCityLoc, a framework that shifts this paradigm to direct feature matching from a noisy 6-DoF pose prior. By extracting surface normals from the query image using a zero-shot foundation model and matching them against rendered LoD normals, we establish explicit 3D-to-2D correspondences. This enables a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) pose solve, which we iteratively refine through a render-and-match loop. Experiments demonstrate strong pose recall and accurate translation and rotation among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods with very few renderings. By bridging the modality gap between aerial imagery and texture-free geometry, MatchCityLoc enables accurate localization using lightweight, privacy-preserving city models.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MatchCityLoc：用零样本基础模型从航拍图像提取表面法向量，与渲染的 LoD 城市模型法向匹配建立 3D-2D 对应，经 PnP 求解位姿，并以渲染—匹配循环迭代精化 6-DoF 位姿。
AI.relevance_reason: 属航空定位与无纹理几何配准，不涉及语言模型推理；但其从基础模型抽取几何证据、并以「渲染—匹配—再检验」迭代精化假设的流程，或可作为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与停止决策的类比线索，需较多核查。
